name: 06-04-language-core-deepening
title: Deepen Chemd language core without device control
description: Deepen Chemd as a chemistry experiment programming language without IDE, training export, or device-control scope. Current phase adds language core fixtures and contract coverage.
creator: hzb666
notes: Phase 1 adds ProgramConditionExpression, parses procedure control condition strings into AST, validates references from AST, and carries structured conditions into canonical procedure controls. Phase 2 adds conservative condition expression type checking for incompatible runtime/reference/literal/quantity comparisons and registers E_CONDITION_TYPE_MISMATCH. Phase 3 adds procedure state/effect contracts, state tags, state violations, and E_PROCEDURE_STATE_INVALID diagnostics for missing mixture, post-quench active-reaction operations, and missing biphasic state. Phase 4 adds standard effects for every step family and carries effects into source-level canonical and typed procedure steps. Phase 5 adds module buildGraph, reverse dependents, changedModules input, and affectedModules output through linker and CLI link reports. Phase 6 adds explainDiagnosticCode, compiler re-export, and CLI explain text/JSON output for known and unknown diagnostic codes. Phase 7 adds semantic diff objects for structured control conditions and per-step procedure state snapshots, and records normalized quantity params in state conditions. Phase 8 adds a language-core compiler fixture plus core contract v0.6 entries for procedure controls, dynamic controls, condition expressions, and structured condition AST support. Verification: core/step-ontology/typechecker/compiler/cli/diagnostics tests, docs coverage tests, and package typechecks passed. pnpm lint remains blocked by ESLint 10.4.0 scopeManager.addGlobals toolchain failure.
